title: Night scene lit only by practicals
summary: At night the scene should be lit by visible sources: lanterns, windows, fire. A global fill kills the effect.
applies_when: the scene contains a light the viewer can point at

values.practical_color_k: 1800-2400 for fire and oil, 2700-3000 for electric

checks: every lit surface can be traced to a visible emitter
the practical itself is not a flat white disc — it has falloff
shadows still read direction; a 360-degree fill flattens them
dark areas stay dark at overview distance
limits: bloom values here assume ACES tone mapping
